changelog:
v3.3.1 — Diagnostic Logging Fix

• Parental Controls: Block any category in Live TV, Movies, or Series — blocked content invisible everywhere
• PIN-gated settings with category toggles, Block All Adult auto-detection
• Auto-blocks adult categories on first PIN setup, 30-min temporary unlock
• Stream Diagnostic Logger: rolling file black box for playback events
• Send Debug Log: upload diagnostics to Firebase, QR code for TV support
• Firebase Crashlytics: automatic crash reporting
• ExoPlayer event logging: state changes, errors, decoder info, buffer health
• Black screen detector: logs no-frame events with full diagnostic context
• Cinematic Hero Banner: 65% screen height, 4-layer gradient system, Ken Burns zoom
• Metadata chips (rating, year, genre), 2-line plot description on hero
• Progress bar countdown, slide transitions, enhanced parallax scroll
• Leanback green brand color fix: forced dark theme on all internal surfaces
• Larger hero title (36sp on TV), right-aligned page indicators
